name: Pyramids of Giza
description: The oldest and largest of the pyramids in the Giza pyramid complex bordering present-day Giza in Greater Cairo, Egypt.

name: Machu Picchu
description: A 15th-century Inca citadel, located in the Eastern Cordillera of southern Peru on a 2,430-meter mountain ridge.

name: Colosseum
description: An oval amphitheatre in the centre of the city of Rome, Italy, just east of the Roman Forum.

name: Petra
description: A historical and archaeological city in southern Jordan, famous for its rock-cut architecture and water conduit system.

name: Taj Mahal
description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the southern bank of the river Yamuna in the Indian city of Agra.

name: Great Wall of China
description: A series of fortifications that were built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states.

name: Chichen Itza
description: A complex of Mayan ruins on Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula. A massive step pyramid, known as El Castillo, dominates the ancient city.

name: Stonehenge
description: A prehistoric monument in Wiltshire, England. It consists of a ring of standing stones, each around 13 feet high.

name: Göbekli Tepe
description: An archaeological site in the Southeastern Anatolia Region of Turkey. The oldest known temple in the world.

name: Ephesus
description: An ancient Greek city on the coast of Ionia, three kilometres southwest of present-day Selçuk in İzmir Province, Turkey.

name: Angkor Wat
description: A temple complex in Cambodia and the largest religious monument in the world by land area.

name: Acropolis of Athens
description: An ancient citadel located on a rocky outcrop above the city of Athens and contains the remains of several ancient buildings.

name: Hagia Sophia
description: A Late Antique place of worship in Istanbul, designed by the Greek geometers Isidore of Miletus and Anthemius of Tralles.

name: Pompeii
description: An ancient city located in what is now the comune of Pompei near Naples in the Campania region of Italy.

name: Teotihuacan
description: An ancient Mesoamerican city located in a sub-valley of the Valley of Mexico, known for its significant Mesoamerican pyramids.

name: Terracotta Army
description: A collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first Emperor of China.

name: Bagan
description: An ancient city and a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Mandalay Region of Myanmar.

name: Easter Island (Moai)
description: Famous for its 887 extant monumental statues, called moai, created by the early Rapa Nui people.

name: Alhambra
description: A palace and fortress complex located in Granada, Andalusia, Spain.

name: Cappadocia
description: A historical region in Central Anatolia, known for its unique 'fairy chimneys' and underground cities.

name: Meteora
description: A rock formation in central Greece hosting one of the largest and most precipitously built complexes of Eastern Orthodox monasteries.

name: Mont Saint-Michel
description: A tidal island and mainland commune in Normandy, France.

name: Borobudur
description: A 9th-century Mahayana Buddhist temple in Magelang Regency, Central Java, Indonesia.

name: Lalibela
description: A town in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia famous for its rock-cut monolithic churches.

name: Timbuktu
description: A city in Mali, situated 20 km north of the Niger River. A center of Islamic learning.

name: Great Zimbabwe
description: A ruined city in the south-eastern hills of Zimbabwe, known for its large circular wall and tower.

name: Persepolis
description: The ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire (c. 550–330 BC).

name: Samarkand
description: A city in southeastern Uzbekistan and among the oldest continuously inhabited cities in Central Asia.

name: Bukhara
description: An ancient city on the Silk Road, known for its well-preserved historic center.

name: Khiva
description: An ancient walled city in Uzbekistan, often called a museum under the open sky.

name: Forbidden City
description: A palace complex in Beijing, China, at the center of the Imperial City.

name: Summer Palace
description: A vast ensemble of lakes, gardens and palaces in Beijing.

name: Temple of Heaven
description: A complex of religious buildings situated in the southeastern part of central Beijing.

name: Potala Palace
description: A dzong fortress in the city of Lhasa, Tibet. Winter palace of the Dalai Lamas.

name: Himeji Castle
description: A hilltop Japanese castle complex situated in the city of Himeji, considered the finest surviving example of prototypical Japanese castle architecture.

name: Kinkaku-ji
description: The Golden Pavilion, a Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto, Japan.

name: Ayutthaya
description: A historic city in Thailand, once the capital of the Kingdom of Siam, destroyed by the Burmese in the 18th century.

name: Sukhothai
description: Capital of the Sukhothai Kingdom in the 13th and 14th centuries.

name: Wat Arun
description: The Temple of Dawn, a Buddhist temple in Bangkok, Thailand.

name: Banaue Rice Terraces
description: 2,000-year-old terraces that were carved into the mountains of Ifugao in the Philippines.

name: Batu Caves
description: A limestone hill that has a series of caves and cave temples in Malaysia.

name: Jeju Island (Dol Hareubang)
description: Known for its unique 'grandmother' stone statues.
